L00027: L00028: ## News L00029: 🚀 Mar. 29, 2024: [v0.8.0](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/releases/tag/v0.8.0) released. Now you can use Data Interpreter ([arxiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.18679), [example](https://docs.deepwisdom.ai/main/en/DataInterpreter/), [code](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/tree/main/examples/di)) via pypi package import. Meanwhile, we integrated RAG module and supported multiple new LLMs. L00030: L00031: 🚀 Feb. 08, 2024: [v0.7.0](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/releases/tag/v0.7.0) released, supporting assigning different LLMs to different Roles. We also introduced [Data Interpreter](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/blob/main/examples/di/README.md), a powerful agent capable of solving a wide range of real-world problems. L00032: L00033: 🚀 Jan. 16, 2024: Our paper [MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework L00034: ](https://openreview.net/forum?id=VtmBAGCN7o) accepted for **oral presentation (top 1.2%)** at ICLR 2024, **ranking #1** in the LLM-based Agent category. L00035: L00036: 🚀 Jan. 03, 2024: [v0.6.0](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/releases/tag/v0.6.0) released, new features include serialization, upgraded OpenAI package and supported multiple LLM, provided [minimal example for debate](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/blob/main/examples/debate_simple.py) etc. L00037: L00038: 🚀 Dec. 15, 2023: [v0.5.0](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/releases/tag/v0.5.0) released, introducing some experimental features such as incremental development, multilingual, multiple programming languages, etc. L00039: L00040: 🔥 Nov. 08, 2023: MetaGPT is selected into [Open100: Top 100 Open Source achievements](https://www.benchcouncil.org/evaluation/opencs/annual.html). L00041: L00042: 🔥 Sep. 01, 2023: MetaGPT tops GitHub Trending Monthly for the **17th time** in August 2023. L00043: L00044: 🌟 Jun. 30, 2023: MetaGPT is now open source. L00045: L00046: 🌟 Apr. 24, 2023: First line of MetaGPT code committed. L00047: L00048: ## Software Company as Multi-Agent System L00049: L00050: 1. MetaGPT takes a **one line requirement** as input and outputs **user stories / competitive analysis / requirements / data structures / APIs / documents, etc.** L00051: 2. Internally, MetaGPT includes **product managers / architects / project managers / engineers.** It provides the entire process of a **software company along with carefully orchestrated SOPs.** L00052: 1. `Code = SOP(Team)` is the core philosophy. We materialize SOP and apply it to teams composed of LLMs. L00053: L00054: ![A software company consists of LLM-based roles](docs/resources/software_company_cd.jpeg) L00055: L00056:

Software Company Multi-Agent Schematic (Gradually Implementing)

L00057: L00058: ## Get Started L00059: L00060: ### Installation L00061: L00062: > Ensure that Python 3.9+ is installed on your system. You can check this by using: `python --version`. L00063: > You can use conda like this: `conda create -n metagpt python=3.9 && conda activate metagpt` L00064: L00065: ```bash L00066: pip install --upgrade metagpt L00067: # or `pip install --upgrade git+https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT.git` L00068: # or `git clone https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT && cd MetaGPT && pip install --upgrade -e .` L00069: ``` L00070: L00071: For detailed installation guidance, please refer to [cli_install](https://docs.deepwisdom.ai/main/en/guide/get_started/installation.html#install-stable-version) L00072: or [docker_install](https://docs.deepwisdom.ai/main/en/guide/get_started/installation.html#install-with-docker) L00073: L00074: ### Configuration L00075: L00076: You can init the config of MetaGPT by running the following command, or manually create `~/.metagpt/config2.yaml` file: L00077: ```bash L00078: # Check https://docs.deepwisdom.ai/main/en/guide/get_started/configuration.html for more details L00079: metagpt --init-config # it will create ~/.metagpt/config2.yaml, just modify it to your needs L00080: ``` L00081: L00082: You can configure `~/.metagpt/config2.yaml` according to the [example](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/blob/main/config/config2.example.yaml) and [doc](https://docs.deepwisdom.ai/main/en/guide/get_started/configuration.html): L00083: L00084: ```yaml L00085: llm: L00086: api_type: "openai" # or azure / ollama / groq etc. Check LLMType for more options L00087: model: "gpt-4-turbo" # or gpt-3.5-turbo L00088: base_url: "https://api.openai.com/v1" # or forward url / other llm url L00089: api_key: "YOUR_API_KEY" L00090: ``` L00091: L00092: ### Usage L00093: L00094: After installation, you can use MetaGPT at CLI L00095: L00096: ```bash L00097: metagpt "Create a 2048 game" # this will create a repo in ./workspace L00098: ``` L00099: L00100: or use it as library L00101: L00102: ```python L00103: from metagpt.software_company import generate_repo, ProjectRepo L00104: repo: ProjectRepo = generate_repo("Create a 2048 game") # or ProjectRepo("") L00105: print(repo) # it will print the repo structure with files L00106: ``` L00107: L00108: You can also use [Data Interpreter](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/tree/main/examples/di) to write code: L00109: L00110: ```python L00111: import asyncio L00112: from metagpt.roles.di.data_interpreter import DataInterpreter L00113: L00114: async def main(): L00115: di = DataInterpreter() L00116: await di.run("Run data analysis on sklearn Iris dataset, include a plot") L00117: L00118: asyncio.run(main()) # or await main() in a jupyter notebook setting L00119: ``` L00120: L00121: L00122: ### QuickStart & Demo Video L00123: - Try it on [MetaGPT Huggingface Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/deepwisdom/MetaGPT) L00124: - [Matthew Berman: How To Install MetaGPT - Build A Startup With One Prompt!!](https://youtu.be/uT75J_KG_aY) L00125: - [Official Demo Video](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/assets/2707039/5e8c1062-8c35-440f-bb20-2b0320f8d27d) L00126: L00127: https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/assets/34952977/34345016-5d13-489d-b9f9-b82ace413419 L00128: L00129: ## Tutorial L00130: L00131: - 🗒 [Online Document](https://docs.deepwisdom.ai/main/en/) L00132: - 💻 [Usage](https://docs.deepwisdom.ai/main/en/guide/get_started/quickstart.html) L00133: - 🔎 [What can MetaGPT do?](https://docs.deepwisdom.ai/main/en/guide/get_started/introduction.html) L00134: - 🛠 How to build your own agents? L00001: """
L00002: Filename: MetaGPT/examples/werewolf_game/evals/eval.py
L00003: Created Date: Oct 18, 2023
L00004: Updated Date: Oct 24, 2023
L00005: Author: [Aria](https://github.com/ariafyy)
L00006: Info: eval the Voting Accuracy Rate of non_werewolves and Vote Difficulity 
L00007: """
L00008: 
L00009: import glob
L00010: import os
L00011: import re
L00012: from pathlib import Path
L00013: 
L00014: import numpy as np
L00015: import pandas as pd
L00016: from tqdm import tqdm
L00017: from utils import Utils
L00018: 
L00019: from metagpt.const import DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ROOT, METAGPT_ROOT
L00020: from metagpt.environment.werewolf.const import RoleType
L00021: 
L00022: 
L00023: class Vote:
L00024:     """Vote Evaluation"""
L00025: 
L00026:     def __init__(self):
L00027:         self.OUT_PATH = DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ROOT / "outputs"
L00028:         os.makedirs(self.OUT_PATH, exist_ok=True)
L00029:         self.SUB_FOLDER_LIST = ["01-10", "11-20", "21-30"]
L00030: 
L00031:     def _get_log_fileslist(self, IN_PATH) -> list[str]:
L00032:         files_list = []
L00033:         for SUB_FOLDER in self.SUB_FOLDER_LIST:
L00034:             files_list.extend(glob.glob(str(IN_PATH / SUB_FOLDER / "*.txt")))
L00035:         return files_list
L00036: 
L00037:     def extract_votes_from_logs(self, files_list: list):
L00038:         for in_logfile in tqdm(files_list):
L00039:             SUB_FOLDER = (Path(in_logfile).parent).stem
L00040:             out_txtfile = self.OUT_PATH / "# {0}_{1}.txt".format(SUB_FOLDER, Path(in_logfile).stem)
L00041:             Utils().pick_vote_log(in_logfile, out_txtfile)
L00042:         votefiles_list = Utils().get_file_list(self.OUT_PATH)
L00043:         return votefiles_list
L00044: 
L00045:     @staticmethod
L00046:     def parse_vote_text2chunks(text: str):
L00047:         """
L00048:         parse each game vote log into text chunks
L00049: 
L00050:         one chunk example:
L00051:         ['Player1', 'Player2', 'Player3', 'Player5', 'Player6']. Say ONLY: I vote to eliminate ...
L00052:         Player1(Witch): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player5
L00053:         Player2(Villager): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player5
L00054:         Player3(Villager): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player5
L00055:         Player5(Werewolf): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player6
L00056:         Player6(Seer): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player5
L00057:         """
L00058:         pattern = re.compile(r"""\[([^\]]+)\]. Say ONLY: I vote to eliminate ...""")
L00059:         chunks = {}
L00060:         chunk_id = 0
L00061:         last_end = 0
L00062:         for match in pattern.finditer(text):
L00063:             start = match.start()
L00064:             chunk = text[last_end:start]
L00065:             chunks[f"vote_{chunk_id}"] = chunk.strip()
L00066:             last_end = match.end()
L00067:             chunk_id += 1
L00068:         final_chunk = text[last_end:].strip()
L00069:         if final_chunk:
L00070:             chunks[f"vote_{chunk_id}"] = final_chunk
L00071:         return chunks
L00072: 
L00073:     def _vote_rate_players(self, text: str):
L00074:         """
L00075:         # calculate the rate of goodteam vote werewolves
L00076:         :example:
L00077: 
L00078:         input:
L00079:         ['Player1', 'Player2', 'Player3', 'Player5', 'Player6']. Say ONLY: I vote to eliminate ...
L00080:         Player1(Witch): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player5
L00081:         Player2(Villager): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player5
L00082:         Player3(Villager): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player5
L00083:         Player5(Werewolf): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player6
L00084:         Player6(Seer): 49 | I vote to eliminate Player5
L00085: 
L00086:         output:
L00087:         werewolves:  ['Player5']
L00088:         non_werewolves: ['Player1', 'Player2', 'Player3', 'Player6']
L00089:         as you can see :Player2(Villager) and   Player3(Villager) vote to eliminate Player5(Werewolf)
L00090:         :return goodteam vote rateability: 100.00%
L00091:         """
L00092:         pattern = re.compile(r"(\w+)\(([^\)]+)\): \d+ \| I vote to eliminate (\w+)")
L00093:         # find all werewolves
L00094:         werewolves = []
L00095:         for match in pattern.finditer(text):
L00096:             if match.group(2) == RoleType.WEREWOLF.value:
L00097:                 werewolves.append(match.group(1))
L00098: 
L00099:         # find all non_werewolves
L00100:         non_werewolves = []
L00101:         for match in pattern.finditer(text):
L00102:             if match.group(2) != RoleType.WEREWOLF.value:
L00103:                 non_werewolves.append(match.group(1))
L00104:         num_non_werewolves = len(non_werewolves)
L00105: 
L00106:         # count players other than werewolves made the correct votes
L00107:         correct_votes = 0
L00108:         for match in pattern.finditer(text):
L00109:             if match.group(2) != RoleType.WEREWOLF.value and match.group(3) in werewolves:
L00110:                 correct_votes += 1
L00111: 
L00112:         # cal the rateability of non_werewolves
L00113:         rate = correct_votes / num_non_werewolves
L00114:         good_vote_rate = round(rate, 2)
L00115:         return {"good_vote_rate": good_vote_rate, "werewolves": werewolves, "non_werewolves": non_werewolves}
L00116: 
L00117:     def get_goodteam_vote_rate(self, text: str) -> float:
L00118:         goodteam_vote_rate = self._vote_rate_players(text)["good_vote_rate"]
L00119:         return goodteam_vote_rate
L00120: 
L00121:     def get_werewolves(self, text: str) -> list:
L00122:         werewolves_list = self._vote_rate_players(text)["werewolves"]
L00123:         return werewolves_list
L00124: 
L00125:     def get_non_werewolves(self, text: str) -> list:
L00126:         non_werewolves_list = self._vote_rate_players(text)["non_werewolves"]
L00127:         return non_werewolves_list
L00128: 
L00129:     def get_votewolf_difficulty(self, werewolves: list, non_werewolves: list) -> str:
L00130:         num_living_wolfs = len(werewolves)
L00131:         num_living_players = len(werewolves) + len(non_werewolves)
L00132:         votewolf_difficulty = "_{0} / {1}".format(num_living_wolfs, num_living_players)
L00133:         return votewolf_difficulty
L00134: 
L00135:     def get_result_df(self, out_txtfile: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
L00136:         """
L00137:         folder:  sub folders for evals
L00138:         file: evaluation file, each file represents one game
L00139:         votes: the number of votes, eg. vote_1 represents the first vote of this game,
L00140:         good_vote_rate:the rateability of a good person voting against a werewolf,
L00141:                    correct_votes / the total number of players other than werewolves
L00142:         total_votes:the total number of votes cast
L00143:         """
L00144:         with open(out_txtfile, "r") as out_file:
L00145:             text = out_file.read()
L00146:             chunks = self.parse_vote_text2chunks(text)
L00147:             res = []
L00148:             for k, v in chunks.items():
L00149:                 if v != "":
L00150:                     chunks_list = list(chunks.keys())
L00151:                     total_votes = len(chunks_list) - 1
L00152:                     werewolves = self.get_werewolves(v)
L00153:                     non_werewolves = self.get_non_werewolves(v)
L00154:                     good_vote_rate = self.get_goodteam_vote_rate(v)
L00155:                     votewolf_difficulty = self.get_votewolf_difficulty(werewolves, non_werewolves)
L00156:                     folder = Utils().filename_to_foldername(out_txtfile)
L00157:                     result = {
L00158:                         "folder": folder,
L00159:                         "file": Path(out_txtfile).stem + ".txt",
L00160:                         "vote_round": k,
L00161:                         "good_vote_rate": good_vote_rate,
L00162:                         "total_votes": total_votes,
L00163:                         "votewolf_difficulty": votewolf_difficulty,
L00164:                     }
L00165:                     res.append(result)
L00166:         df = pd.DataFrame(res)
L00167:         return df
L00168: 
L00169:     def calc_avg_rate(self, IN_PATH) -> pd.DataFrame:
L00170:         """
L00171:         get avg_rate for each game
L00172:         avg_rate : the good_rate/total number of votes in the game
L00173:         vote1_rate: First Round Voting Accuracy Rate
L00174:         """
L00175:         infiles_list = self._get_log_fileslist(IN_PATH)
L00176:         votefiles_list = self.extract_votes_from_logs(infiles_list)
L00177:         df_list = [self._load_df_from_file(file) for file in votefiles_list]
L00178:         combined_df = pd.concat(df_list, ignore_index=True)
L00179:         # calculate the average good_vote_rate for each file
L00180:         mean_rates = self._calculate_mean_rates(combined_df)
L00181:         combined_df["avg_rate"] = combined_df["file"].map(mean_rates)
L00182:         # calculate vote1 rate
L00183:         vote1_rates = self._calc_vote1_rates(combined_df)
L00184:         combined_df["vote1_rate"] = combined_df["folder"].map(vote1_rates.set_index("folder")["good_vote_rate"])
L00185:         combined_df.loc[combined_df["vote_round"] != "vote_1", "vote1_rate"] = np.nan
L00186:         combined_df["vote1_rate"] = combined_df["vote1_rate"].apply(self._format_rates)
L00187:         combined_df["good_vote_rate"] = combined_df["good_vote_rate"].apply(self._format_rates)
L00188:         combined_df["avg_rate"] = combined_df["avg_rate"].apply(self._format_rates)
L00189:         combined_df.sort_values(["file"], ascending=True, inplace=True)
L00190:         return combined_df
L00191: 
L00192:     def _calc_vote1_rates(self, df):
L00193:         df_vote1 = df[df["vote_round"] == "vote_1"]
L00194:         vote1_rates = df_vote1.groupby("folder")["good_vote_rate"].mean().reset_index()
L00195:         return vote1_rates
L00196: 
L00197:     def _load_df_from_file(self, file):
L00198:         return self.get_result_df(file)
L00199: 
L00200:     def _calculate_mean_rates(self, df):
L00201:         return df.groupby("file")["good_vote_rate"].mean()
L00202: 
L00203:     def _format_rates(self, s):
L00204:         return Utils().float_to_percent(s)
L00205: 
L00206:     def get_eval_csv(self, IN_PATH, EVAL_RESULT):
L00207:         """
L00208:         IN_PATH : parent folder of ["01-10", "11-20", "21-30"]
L00209:         EVAL_RESULT : output csv file path
L00210:         """
L00211:         combined_df = self.calc_avg_rate(IN_PATH)
L00212:         combined_df.to_csv(EVAL_RESULT, index=False)
L00213: 
L00214: 
L00215: if __name__ == "__main__":
L00216:     IN_PATH = METAGPT_ROOT / "examples/werewolf_game/evals"
L00217:     EVAL_RESULT = DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ROOT / "outputs" / "goodteam_vote_rate.csv"
L00218:     Vote().get_eval_csv(IN_PATH, EVAL_RESULT)

L00001: """
L00002: Filename: MetaGPT/examples/werewolf_game/evals/utils.py
L00003: Created Date: Oct 11, 2023
L00004: Revised Date: Oct 20, 2023
L00005: Author: [Aria](https://github.com/ariafyy)
L00006: """
L00007: import glob
L00008: import os
L00009: import re
L00010: from pathlib import Path
L00011: 
L00012: from metagpt.const import METAGPT_ROOT
L00013: 
L00014: 
L00015: class Utils:
L00016:     """Utils: utils of logs"""
L00017: 
L00018:     @staticmethod
L00019:     def polish_log(in_logfile, out_txtfile):
L00020:         """polish logs for evaluation"""
L00021:         pattern_text = r"(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d{3}) \| (\w+) +\| ([\w\.]+:\w+:\d+) - (.*\S)"
L00022:         pattern_player = r"(Player(\d{1}): \w+)"
L00023:         pattern_start = False
L00024:         json_start = False
L00025: 
L00026:         with open(in_logfile, "r") as f, open(out_txtfile, "w") as out:
L00027:             for line in f.readlines():
L00028:                 matches = re.match(pattern_text, line)
L00029:                 if matches:
L00030:                     message = matches.group(4).strip()
L00031:                     pattern_start = True
L00032:                     json_start = False
L00033: 
L00034:                     if (
L00035:                         "Moderator(Moderator) ready to InstructSpeak" not in message
L00036:                         and "Moderator(Moderator) ready to ParseSpeak" not in message
L00037:                         and "Total running cost:" not in message
L00038:                     ):
L00039:                         out.write("- " + message + "\n")
L00040:                     else:
L00041:                         out.write("\n")
L00042: 
L00043:                 elif pattern_start and not matches:
L00044:                     if "gpt-4 may update over time" in line:
L00045:                         line = ""
